== Published English Original Virtual Set 7 wording ==
The remaster raises deploy to 4, drops the protection against reducing forfeit and the added battle destiny with Xizor, and gives the express option to forfeit Guri to absorb remaining battle damage. The Force drain modifier names Coruscant sites. Other printed statistics, pilot/warrior icons and immunities remain.
